program.name: Boxing Volume
program.subject: Boxing
program.blurb: Long boxing sessions: plenty of rounds, then a circuit or Tabatas.
program.about: Boxing with the rounds a real session has. Each day is a long run of shadowboxing bouts, jabs and crosses, power combinations, slips and rolls, then a bodyweight circuit one day and Tabatas the next. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Both later levels bring longer combinations and harder moves.
program.split: Long bouts & circuit / long bouts & Tabatas
